package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi-std/sdk/v2/go/std"
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/ssl"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		invokeFile, err := std.File(ctx, &std.FileArgs{
			Input: "xxx.crt",
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		invokeFile1, err := std.File(ctx, &std.FileArgs{
			Input: "xxx.key",
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = ssl.NewUpdateCertificateInstanceOperation(ctx, "update_certificate_instance", &ssl.UpdateCertificateInstanceOperationArgs{
			OldCertificateId:      pulumi.String("xxx"),
			CertificatePublicKey:  pulumi.String(invokeFile.Result),
			CertificatePrivateKey: pulumi.String(invokeFile1.Result),
			Repeatable:            pulumi.Bool(true),
			ResourceTypes: pulumi.StringArray{
				pulumi.String("cdn"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
